| cfg_url = }} Contrary to popular belief, Soma is a QuakeWorld player from [[Luxembourg]] and not from [[Germany]]. He started playing QuakeWorld actively in [[2003]] and focussed on playing [[1on1|duels]] and [[FFA]] for the first year. Rapidly falling in love with the game's physics and the vast possibilities in the area of [[trick jumping]], Soma released a somewhat popular trick jumping video titled [[Misusing Explosives]] within his first year of active playing. After some duels in [[2004]], [[Rayden]] convinced Soma to give teamplay a chance and thus recruited him for German clan [[pOrn]]. After a semi-successful [[GEQL Season 1]], [[Rayden]] disappeared and [[pOrn]] disbanded. Soon later however, [[Rotten]] decided to form a new team - [[Last Episode]] - and asked Soma to be part of the roster. Other than a few prac games and an inactive participation (only 1 official game played) of [[NQR Summercup|NQR Summercup 2004]], then clan soon disbanded again when Rotten decided to part ways with Last Episode to join [[Be Evil]]. Soma then joined his first 'serious' clan when he decided to play with [[Smack that Ass]], with whom he was able to win Division 5 of [[NQR Season 8]], his first success in teamplay. When in [[2006]] however some key members of Smack that Ass, such as [[Massaka]] and [[drd]], went inactive and the team hit a new low in terms of activity and performance, Soma decided to part ways Smack that Ass in order to start up a new team together with [[Flow]] and [[Cyrax]], clan [[Dies Ater]]. == Setup == {| width="60%" | valign="top" | * '''CPU''': Intel Pentium 4 1.8GHz * '''GPU''': GeForce3 Ti200 * '''Monitors''': Medion 19" * '''Mouse''': Logitech mx518 (500hz) * '''Pad''': Noname Rubber/cloth * '''Keyboard''': Greybusters (Spongebob Edition) * '''Headphones''': Philips SHP I 900 * '''Soundcard''': Soundblaster Audigy SE * '''Client''': [[fuhQuake|fuhQuake v0.31 (Build 675)]] * '''Resolution''': 640 x 480 (GL) | valign="top" | [[Image:somafuh.jpg|right|thumb|230px|Soma's fuhQuake setup]] |} == Contributions == * '''[[QuakeWorld Summerjam]]''' - Founder and head admin * '''[[Nations Quake Rank]]''' - Lead Admin * '''[[German QuakeWorld Scene]]''' - Newswriter and editor * '''[[qwdrama]]''' - Admin == Videos == * [[2003]] - [[Misusing Explosives]] == Trivia == * Has actually played QW for the first time at a lan in northern Luxembourg in [[1997]]. However, a short-circuit rapidly led to the death of Soma's computer just a few hours after his arrival at the lan. On top of that, Soma got over 39° of fever the same evening and eventually had to be driven home by an older attendant of the lan. Soma never touched QW again until [[2003]] and never again visited a lan until [[2006]]. * Both his nick as well as his aliases have origins of personal interest. ** "Soma" is a drug prescribed by the government in the utopia/dystopia novel 'Brave New World' by Aldous Huxley.[[#References|[1]]] ** "Żegota" was an underground organisation in Nazi occupied Poland from 1942-1945, offering aid to jews living in occupied areas.[[#References|[2]]] ** "Vulture" comes from the song 'Eagles become Vultures' by hardcore punkrock band 'Converge'.[[#References|[3]]] ** "Cutthroat" is a type of game-play in the dart game 'Cricket', a popular "pub sport".[[#References|[4]]] == Quotes == <[Soma]> dass ich eigentlich ein spinner bin, wird sie früher oder später schon rausfinden
